name: Sarking — blog
summary: A blog for long-form writing with charts, tables and evidence
description: A blog for people who write with evidence: long-form posts in plain Markdown with charts, comparison tables, verdicts, timelines and callouts; authors, series, topics, an archive, search and full-text feeds; a Markdown copy of every page for AI agents. Eighteen section types, four templates and three looks, each light and dark.
